serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Software and AI supply-chain adjudication: a customer submits a repository or container image; NINELINE produces a CycloneDX SBOM, matches it against vulnerability data, and adjudicates each finding with a deterministic call-graph engine, returning a VEX document in which every statement carries its evidence.

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: NINELINE trust center: public information, the public service list and progress toward certification for anyone; the FedRAMP Certification Package (CPO, SDR with daily KSI data, VDR/VER reports) for signed-in agency, FedRAMP and assessor users.
additionalRepositories.accessRequestInstructions: Email ryan@gooptimal.io from a government address with your agency and role; Optimal creates the account (MFA required) and records the grant.

certified.useCase: Amazon Web Services / AWS GovCloud (US): ECS on Fargate, ECR, Elastic Load Balancing, WAF, Network Firewall, NAT Gateway, VPC, Route 53 (DNSSEC), Certificate Manager, RDS for PostgreSQL, EFS, S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, Cognito, IAM Identity Center, API Gateway, Lambda, EventBridge Scheduler, SQS, SNS, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, Config, Security Hub, GuardDuty, Inspector, IAM Access Analyzer, AWS Backup, Bedrock
Google Workspace: Email for Optimal staff and for alert notification; not an identity provider to the boundary
GitHub Enterprise Cloud: Source control; pull-request change control record; CI/CD pipeline; OIDC issuer for the AWS deploy role
